title: Kaling Channel Terminal
safeHtml:
Kaling Channel Terminal is one of the piers of Metro-Vector-Paw Container Terminals. It is located at Los Sengas Downtown.

Description[]

  • Terminal Number: 4
  • Location: Los Sengas Downtown Kaling Channel
  • Color Scheme: Light Green
  • Land Area: 65.67 Hectares
  • Coast Length: 1.379 km
  • Number of Containers: 120,840
  • Number of Cranes: 21
  • Connecting Stations: East Ring Line, Lima Line Kaling Channel Station, Leanpool Line Kaling Channel Station

Technical Information and Characteristics[]

  • Kaling Channel Station is built to commemorate the completion of this terminal and West Ring Line.

title: Kaling Sea
safeHtml:
Kaling Sea is one of the lakes in Los Sengas, and is located to the south of Katadelphia. Kaling Sea is one of the only two lakes that are named "Sea" in Los Sengas, the other being Internal Sea.

Contents

  • 1 Location
  • 2 Transport
    • 2.1 Railways
    • 2.2 Roads
  • 3 Citations and References

Location[]

Kaling Sea is located to the south of Katadelphia, the east of Kaling Channel Terminal of Metro-Vector-Paw Container Terminals. It faces the desert in three sides, and a mountain to the north, where Kaling River joins Kaling Sea.

Station Souvenir Hints (Now Demolished)[]

 The following text contains large amounts of spoilers. Read with caution.

  • Stars: 2
  • Take your Bow and Arrow
  • Make sure that you shoot the TNT cart and that the TNT explodes before it falls into the pit.
  • The Station Souvenir comes in the form of an Iron Ingot.

Station Gauntlet[]

  • The theme and challenge modes of this Station Gauntlet are as follows:
    • Solo
    • Shooter
    • Moving Targets

Station Gauntlet Hints[]

 The following text contains large amounts of spoilers. Read with caution.
  • Stars: 2
  • Take your Bow and Arrow and shoot at least 8 out of 10 Minecarts.
  • Prevent the Minecarts from reaching the end.
  • The Station Gauntlet Souvenir comes in the form of a Block of Gold.

Fun Facts[]

  • The glass panel of the Station Control Room at this station is over 20m long and is the largest piece of glass panel in Nazca Railway.

History[]

  • June 2 2015: This station began services.
  • May 12 2016: This station finished Upgrading Works.[4]
  • November 11 2017: This station completed replacement of direction and platform signs.[5]
  • September 13 2022: The Station Banners of this station are set up.[6]
  • October 25 2024: The "Station Gauntlet" of this station is set up.[7]
  • November 16 2025: This station completed its Station Title and Icon Upgrade Scheme.[8]

Kaling Station is a station on Stadium Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at the east edge of Los Sengas Katadelphia. This station is named after the Kaling River to the east of this station, and crosses above Katadelphia Circular Highway. Passengers may also use this station to change to Katadelphia Railway South Nager Line, Muiling Line (East Kaling Station).

Fun Facts[]

  • This station shares structure with Katadelphia Railway East Kaling Station.
  • This Station is the first station in Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division) to have its own wiki page.

Station Souvenir Hints (Now Demolished)[]

 The following text contains large amounts of spoilers. Read with caution.

  • Stars: 0.5-1
  • Become a Marksman, and shoot arrows at the target aim.
  • The Station Souvenir comes in the form of a block of gold.

Station Gauntlet[]

  • The theme and challenge modes of this Station Gauntlet are as follows:
    • Solo
    • Archery
    • Timing

Note: Before proceeding to the challenge, please ensure that you have no personal belongings with you to ensure that your inventory is not cleared.

Hints[]

 The following text contains large amounts of spoilers. Read with caution.
  • Stars: 2
  • Determine the order and timing at which the buttons are shot at in accordance to the time taken for each set of redstone lights to shine from the edge to the gold bar in such a way that all the redstone lights at the gold bar would be lit at the same time.
  • The first and last arrows should be shot at a time interval between 17 and 18 seconds.
  • The Station Gauntlet Souvenir comes in the form of an arrow.
Redstone Lights

History[]

  • May 7 2015: This station began services.
  • March 20 2016: This station finished Upgrading Works.[2]
  • January 28 2017: This station completed replacement of direction and platform signs.[3]
  • June 14 2017: This station finished Second Stage Upgrading Works.[4]
  • July 3 2022: The Station Banners of this station are set up.[5]
  • November 4 2022: The "Station Gauntlet" of this station is set up.[6]

History[]

Kallen Road used to connect Diamond Pool and Inception Bay Station. It has been extended to Nagasora to serve as a road run-through Twenty-Second Continent.

Kamelen Station is a station on Origin Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas Katadelphia. Passengers may also use this station to change to Katadelphia Railway Muiga Line, Melen Line (Kamelen Station).

Fun Facts[]

  • This Station is the second station in Nazca Railway after Metro Stone Station, as well as the first bidirectional station, to be inserted bewteen two existing stations, and is also the first station to be added between Origin Station and Flask North Station.
  • The station number of Origin Line for this station was 13-02. However, it has later been changed to 13-03 with the completion of Samenta Station.
  • The Original Name of this station was Katalajara Station.

History[]

  • February 16 2020: This station began services.
  • July 14 2022: Due to the completion of Samenta Station, the Origin Line station number has changed from 13-02 to 13-03.[2]

Kapa Channel Island is an artificial island on which Kapa Channel Station and its corresponding Premium Lounge is located.

Location[]

Kapa Channel Island is located directly to the south of Styrgate Road near a Bus Stop. In terms of districts, it is located to the north of West Metropolis Archipelago, the west of Odyssey and the east of Peckern North.

Transport[]

Railway[]

Kapa Channel Station is the station that serves as the railway hub of this island. It is served by Phoenix Line.

Trunk Roads[]

Currently, Styrgate Road provides a bus stop that connects to this island.

Roads[]

This island consists of various pedestrian paths that forms a gridlike pattern and conntects across all facilities on this island.

Facilities[]

This island features a Station with its own Premium Lounge, three separate wings of NR Shops and an Outdoor Concert Hall as follows:

Kapa Channel Station[]

More info on this chatper could be seen at Kapa Channel Station.

Kapa Channel Station is the station that serves as the railway hub of this island. It is located at the south of this island in terms of the island length, and is located at its center in terms of the island width. It is also located to the south of the Kapa Channel Premium Lounge, and connects with Peckern North to the west towards Poon Tong Station, as well as Odyssey to the east towards Skyhorse Station, where further connections to the West Metropolis Archipelago Northeast and Express Services are provided by Stadow Line and Golf Line respectively.

Kapa Channel Premium Lounge[]

More info on this chatper could be seen at Kapa Channel Premium Lounge.

Kapa Channel Premium Lounge is located to the direct north of station structure of Kapa Channel Station. It is also the first Premium Lounge to not be located within the station that serves it and is an indepenent two-storey structure.

West Wing NR Shops[]

On the west side of this island are 20 NR Shops that are coded KCH-01 to KCH-20, as well as two restaurant Shops, namely KCH-R01 and KCH-R02.

East Wing NR Shops[]

On the east side of this island are 20 additional NR Shops that are coded KCH-21 to KCH-40, as well as two restaurant Shops, namely KCH-R03 and KCH-R04.

South Wing NR Shops[]

Besides of the 44 NR Shops above, 17 shops are also placed directly to the south of Kapa Channel Station, cded KCH-41 to KCH-57.

Outdoor Concert Hall[]

The Outdoor Concert Hall is located directly to the north of Kapa Channel Premium Lounge and is sandwiched between the West and East Wings of the NR Shops. The Outdoor Concert Hall can serve up to an audience of 1,064 people in total.

Fun Facts[]

  • This artificial island is not reclaimed to the seabed. Instead, it is supported by a total of 96 support pillars that are built from the seabed. Therefore, this "Island" is better described as a Floating Platform. Nonetheless, this floating platform is named Kapa Channel Island for convenience purposes.
  • The size of this "island" can be contributed to the fact that it is also used as a Service Area of passengers using the bus stop on Styrgate Road for bus interchanges.

History[]

  • November 24 2024: The Station Structure of Kapa Channel Station began construction.
  • November 25 2024: This island completed reclamation works. At the same day, The Station Structure of Kapa Channel Station completed construction.
  • November 26 2024: Kapa Channel Station completed construction.
  • November 27 2024: Kapa Channel Station began services.

Description[]

In terms of Island Facilities, this Premium Lounge is located to the direct north of the Kapa Channel Station Structure, to the south of the Outdoor Concert Hall, and is sandwiched between two wings of NR Shops. The Premium Lounge itself is a two-storey structure with the same livery as Kapa Channel Station.

Fun Facts[]

  • This is the first Premium Lounge to be built as a separate structure from the station that it is linked to (Kapa Channel Station).
  • The background image of This Wiki is taken at the Reception Area of this Premium Lounge.
  • All facilities in this Premium Lounge have a unique English Name.
  • Due to Presence of a Swimming Pool in this Premium Lounge, the Bathrooms in this Premium Lounge are not located within the lavatories. Instead, they are located in the Changing Rooms.
  • Television Screens are available at urinals and sinks of the lavatories in a fashion similar to the Centopia Premium Lounge.

Kata River Station is a station on Stadium Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at the west edge of Los Sengas Katadelphia. This station is located to the east of Katadelphia Circular Highway, and passengers may also use this station to change to Katadelphia Railway Lingta Line, Lincity Line (Westa Station).

Station Souvenir Hints[]

 The following text contains large amounts of spoilers. Read with caution.
  • Stars: 2-2.5
  • Don't look at the surface.
  • Slowly search for the location.
  • The Station Souvenir comes in the form of a Gold Ingot.

Station Gauntlet[]

  • The theme and challenge modes of this Station Gauntlet are as follows:
    • Solo
    • Memory
    • Pattern

Note: Before proceeding to the challenge, please ensure that you have no personal belongings with you to ensure that your inventory is not cleared.

Hints[]

 The following text contains large amounts of spoilers. Read with caution.
  • Stars: 2
  • Not only do you have to memorize all the images, you also have to remember the location of each colored pillar in each image.
  • Not all images are at the same height.
  • The Station Gauntlet Souvenir comes in the form of a nether star.

Fun Facts[]

  • This station is named after Kata Ho, the Chinese Name of one of the Project Nazca players. His name is also used to name the nearby Kata River, hence the name of this station.
  • This station adopts the Spanish Solution.
  • This station alludes to Choi Hung Station of the MTR in Hong Kong.

History[]

  • May 2 2015: This station began services.
  • March 18 2016: This station finished Upgrading Works.[4]
  • December 7 2016: This station adopts a new exit sign.[5]
  • January 23 2017: This station completed replacement of direction and platform signs.[6]
  • June 12 2017: This station finished Second Stage Upgrading Works.[7]
  • June 5 2022: The Station Banners of this station are set up.[8]
  • August 3 2022: This station completed expansion, adding a greening area, a leisure area and NR Shops.[9]
  • October 8 2022: The "Station Gauntlet" of this station is set up.[10]

title: Katadelphia Depot
safeHtml:
Katadelphia Depot is the first depot to be built in Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division. It is located at Los Sengas Katadelphia, and began services on May 5 2015. This Depot provides services for New Edward Line, Stadium Line, Xofa Line, Arcgo Line, Kinight Line, Zephyr Line, Origin Line, Interisland Line, Gondola Line, Stadow Line, Alpha Line, Bravo Line, Charlie Line, Delta Line and Fox Line.

Contents

  • 1 Description
  • 2 Depot Structure
  • 3 Gallery
  • 4 Citations and References

Description[]

Katadelphia Depot is located to the south of Katadelphia Station. It has a total land area of 11.6 Hectares, and has a total of 29 tracks that totals 15.36 km in length. The Depot is 845 m long and 120 m wide, with the main building being 431 m long.

Depot Structure[]

Stabling Sidings
  • Main: 18 Sidings (A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H, J, K, L, M, N, P, Q, R, S, T), Stores a total of 36 trains, each with 8 carriages.
  • Auxiliar: 6 Sidings (U, V, W, X, Y Z), Stores a total of 5 trains, each with 8 carriages. However, upon expansion, it would be able to contain 10 to 20 8-carriage trains.
Depot Platforms
  • A pair of Standard Length (204 m) Island Platforms.
  • Currently for Spare use and is not open to the public.
  • Does not feature Platform Screen Doors.
Maintenance Pit
  • Located at the south of the depot. Two Maintenance Pits, each 244 m long, is set up for the convenience of vehicle maintenance.
Connecting Tracks

The Depot has two sets of tracks connecting to the railway network, one to the east and one to the west:

  • West Entrance: Connects to Kata River Station Platforms 2, 3. Enters the depot from the underground.
  • East Entrance: Connects to the tracks between Katadelphia Station and Kaling Station.

Station Souvenir Hints[]

 The following text contains large amounts of spoilers. Read with caution.
  • Stars: 2
  • Jump from the sides of the passageway onto the area above Alpha Line tracks.
  • Try jumping into the right hole. There are three holes in total.
  • The Station Souvenir comes in the form of an emerald.

Station Characteristics[]

  • This station is the only station in which Nazca Railway lines and Katadelphia Railway lines completely use the same structure.
  • This station is the only Checkpoint to be built in 2016, and is also the second Checkpoint in Los Sengas Division (With the first being Rover Down Checkpoint).
  • This station is the 100th station to be built in the Los Sengas Division.

Future Development[]

  • This station may become the transport hub for interchange with SLT and other transportation means.

History[]

  • April 13 2016: This station began operations alongside Arcgo Line. Alpha Line platforms remain reserved.
  • May 3 2016: Alpha Line extended from Zootuary Station to this station. Alpha Line is established.
  • July 24 2018: This station completed replacement of signs.[2]
  • November 23 2024: The Station Banners of this station are set up.[3]
  • October 29 2025: This station completed its Station Title and Icon Upgrade Scheme.[4]

Katadelphia Station is a station on Stadium Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas Katadelphia. Station Souvenir Hints (Now Demolished)[]

 The following text contains large amounts of spoilers. Read with caution.

  • Stars: 0.5-1
  • Look for a set of stairs that climb down.
  • Keep Running and press the button.

  • Due to the construction of Katadelphia City Center Node, the passageway connecting to the Station Souvenir has been sealed up starting from June 8 2019.

Station Gauntlet[]

  • The theme and challenge modes of this Station Gauntlet are as follows:
    • Co-Op (2 Persons)
    • Sequence

Fun Facts[]

  • Katadelphia Depot, which alludes to Kowloon Bay Depot of the MTR, is situated to the south of this station.
  • This station, as well as the merging tracks to the east of this station, alludes to Kowloon Bay Station of the MTR in Hong Kong.
  • While this station was the first station in Los Sengas Division to use Basic Platform Gates, they have since been replaced by Heightened Basic Platform Gates after the construction of Katadelphia City Center Node.

History[]

  • May 3 2015: This station began services.
  • March 18 2016: This station finished Upgrading Works.[2]
  • December 7 2016: This station adopts a new exit sign.[3]
  • January 24 2017: This station completed replacement of direction and platform signs.[4]
  • June 13 2017: This station finished Second Stage Upgrading Works.[5]
  • June 11 2019: Exit C is added to this station to connect to Katadelphia City Center Node.
  • June 14 2020: Exit D is added to this station.[6]
  • July 3 2022: The Station Banners of this station are set up.[7]
  • October 18 2022: The "Station Gauntlet" of this station is set up.[8]
  • December 24 2023: The Station Title Banner of this station is added.
  • June 7 2024: This station completed its Station Title and Icon Upgrade Scheme.

Fun Facts[]

  • The design and layout of the aboveground section of this station alludes to Valor Station, with regards that the station features a cover above the outdoors space, and the Pegasus Line Platforms of this Station alludes to its platforms at The Colonnade Station.

History[]

  • March 10 2026: This Station began construction.
  • March 13 2026: This Station completed construction.
  • March 14 2026: This Station began services alongside Lingshan Line, but Pegasus Line Platforms remain reserved.
  • March 29 2026: Pegasus Line extends from The Colonnade Station to this station through Densewood Station.

title: Kelper Mount
safeHtml:
Kelper Mount is one of the Sub-Districts of Punctual. It is currently a well-developed new town that integrates elements of other players.

Contents

  • 1 History
  • 2 Transport
    • 2.1 Roads
    • 2.2 Routes

  • 3 Points of Interest
    • 3.1 Landmarks

History[]

Development of Kelper Mount began in June 2017 when Nazca Railway constructed two roads and dozens of residential and commercial plots near Kelper Mount Station in hopes that players have more room and opportunity for urban development.

After Kelper Mount Station began services, a Building Team member constructed the Phase I of Kelper Mount New Town around the station. Phase I begun from the north, and contains a total of 136 plots, ending at Ka Yi Street to the south and Ka Chan Street to the west. To increase the convenience of access, a wrap to Kelper Mount New Town is also set up near the Spawn Point.

Due to the popularity of the plots, the Building Team Member proposed Phase II development of Kelper Mount New Town in the form of 70 additional plots to the southwest, as well as reserved space for public housing and hospitals. However, Kelper Mount has not seen any significant development since.

Fun Facts[]

  • This station is the second of a series of three stations that are built to commemorate a friend of the Railway Builder, with the other two stations being Johnson Views Station and Newmonth River Station.
  • The design of this station pays tribute to Greenrock Hill Station.
  • The East Ring Line Platforms of this station is 256m long.

History[]

  • June 21 2017: This station began services alongside East Ring Line.
  • January 1 2018: This station finished Second Stage Upgrading Works.[2]
  • January 15 2018: Through Service between East Ring Line and New Edward Line Litchi Lake Station is added at Platform 1 of this station.
  • January 22 2018: This station completed expansion of the Delta Line section, but Delta Line Platforms remain reserved.[3]
  • January 27 2018: Delta Line extends from Dusty Station to this station.

Fun Facts[]

  • After the establishment of Line 3102, the station has undergone an expansion and has two platforms added to it. To guarantee the Shuttle Functionality and train density of Line 3101 between Key River Station and the nearby hotel, Platforms 1 and 2 are designed to be bi-direction in a fashion similar to Line 407 at Fare Well Cliff Station in Terracept Division.

Station Title and Soundtrack[]

  • The Station Title of this Station is Unity Fulcrum.
  • This Station features two soundtracks that belong to the album "From Abyss to Aether".
Name of the Soundtrack Length (mm:ss)
Unity Fulcrum 03:24
Crownstone Axis 02:13

Fun Facts[]

  • This Station is named after the Keystone Asterism within the Hercules Constellation, which in turn is named after the Heracles, the Greek Divine Hero. However, the Chinese Name of this station is lost in translation when compared to the Chinese Name of the Asterism.
  • This Station features two Station Control Rooms, one for the use of Rover Line and Odyssey Circular, and the other is for the use of Lima Line.

History[]

  • January 22 2025: This Station began construction.
  • January 26 2025: This Station completed construction.
  • January 27 2025: This Station began services alongside Rover Line, but Odyssey Circular and Lima Line Platforms remain reserved.
  • March 25 2025: This station completed setting up of Odyssey Circular and Lima Line systems.
  • March 26 2025: Odyssey Circular extends from Gwynfield Station to this station.
  • March 27 2025: Lima Line extends from Sirius Station to this station.
  • July 14 2025: The Station Icon of this station is added.

Description []

Kilo Line is one of the Veloducts of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division. It runs along Prymea and Cometsilk.

This line is represented by Blue on the Nazca Railway Route Map, and is Line Number K.

History[]

  • S2E17: Nail Bight - Pi Lake
  • S4E10: Spring Point - Pi Lake

Nazca Railway 2021 Development Outline[]

Direction Development Details Progress
Up Extend Northwards from Pi Lake Station to Daisy Island Station, where it interchanges with East Ring Line once again. TBC

Nazca Railway Development Plan 2024 Edition[]

Direction Development Details Progress
Up Extend Northwards from Pi Lake Station to Daisy Island Station through Abunest. TBC
Down Extend Southeast from Nail Bight Checkpoint to Spring Point Gateway. Completed
(Chapter: S4E10)

Districts Served[]

  • Prymea
  • Cometsilk

Line Characteristics[]

  • One of the Veloducts of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division.
  • This line will extend to East Ring Line Daisy Island Station in the future.
  • This line provides Express Services for the following lines:
    • Starshore Line: Nail Bight - Spring Point

Fun Facts[]

  • Among the existing Nazca Railway lines which have not completed development, this line holds the record for having the longest timespan without any development.[1]
  • Currently, this line holds the record for having the longest timespan without any development of 8 years and 3 months and having known plans to extend, from its extension to Pi Lake Station on February 20 2018 to its extension to Spring Point Gateway in 2026.[2]

Kingsborough Station is a station on Oasis Bay Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas Oasis Bay. This station will serve Abyss Line in the future, and passengers may also use this station to change to Element Hub Transit Evillow Line, Evillow Express (Kingsborough Station).

Description []

Kinight Line is one of the District lines of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division. It runs across West Metropolis Archipelago and Twenty-Second Continent.

This route is represented by Pink on the Nazca Railway Route Map, and is Line Number 9.

Currently, this route is 9.695 km long, with a total of 8 stations.

History[]

  • S1E16: Edward Island - Comic Ward
  • S2E17: Edward Island - Zerda Hill
  • S3E12: Edward Island - Voycrane
  • S3E13P2: Edward Island / Sheung Che Nung - Darey Terrace

Nazca Railway 2021 Development Outline[]

Direction Development Details Progress
Up Extend to the south from Darey Terrace Station and enter Teraleros through the Strait of Freedom, interchanging with Oasis Bay Line, Vision Line and Epsilon Line in the process. TBC

Nazca Railway Development Plan 2024 Edition[]

Direction Development Details Progress
Up Extend Southwards from Darey Terrace Station to Markost Station through Joyhill Island and Sandshore Island. TBC

Districts Served[]

  • West Metropolis Archipelago (Edward Island)
  • Twenty-Second Continent

Line Charcteristics[]

  • The first District Line of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division.
  • The name of this line is based on the nickname of the former Director of Discipline in Project Nazca.
  • This line has already been developed into a "Y-shaped" line in a fashion similar to New Edward Line. Like New Edward Line, this line also has three termini (Edward Island, Sheung Che Nung, Darey Terrace). Therefore, at the time of Sheung Che Nung Station's completion, that station already has reserved platforms and turn-back sidings.
  • Both Edward Island Checkpoint and Sheung Che Nung Station are downward termini of this line.
  • One of the termini (Edward Island) is located on West Metropolis Archipelago, and features cross-platform interchange with Interisland Line.
  • Express Services of this line:
    • Bravo Line (West): Edward Island to Darey Terrace (Through Zerda Hill).

Kioku Island is one of the islands involved in the Centopia Nazca Railway Headquarters. Similar to Centopia Island and the other islands in Centopia, this island is also artificial.

Contents

  • 1 Location
  • 2 Transport
    • 2.1 Railway
    • 2.2 Road
  • 3 Fun Facts
  • 4 Future Development
  • 5 History
  • 6 Citations and References

Location[]

Kioku Island is located to the northeast of Centopia Island and the southwest of Airship Island. It also sits at the northeastern edge of Centopia.

Transport[]

Railway[]

This island features Kioku Station of the Utopia Line, and it currently serves as a means of access between Centopia and Airship Island.

Road[]

Currently, this island features a main road connecting to Centopia Island to the west and Airship Island to the east, as well as two local roads. One road runs in parallel with the west coast, and the other runs in parallel with the north and northwest coasts. Kioku Station is located at the intersection between the main road and the second local road.

Fun Facts[]

  • The channel that exists between Centopia Island to the southwest and this island is 150m wide.
  • The name of this island Kioku is taken from the Japanese language, and corresponds to the Chinese Name of this island, which means "Memory".[1]

Future Development[]

During the planning stages of Utopia Line, Kioku Station, the station that serves this island, was named Museum Station, and when combined with the Chinese Name of this island, Memory, it implies that a museum may be built on this island in the future.

History[]

  • August 3 2023: This island completed reclamation works.
  • August 5 2023: This island completed road pavement, and the road link to Centopia Island completed construction.
  • August 29 2023: Kioku Station began services.
  • September 18 2023: The road link to Airship Island completed construction.

Fun Facts[]

  • This page is the 2800th page of this wiki.
  • The channel that exists between The Island on which this station is located (Kioku) and Centopia Island is 150m wide.
  • At the planning stage, this station was named Museum Station.
  • The name of this station Kioku is taken from the Japanese language, and corresponds to the Chinese Name of its island, which means "Memory".[4]
  • The Station Passageway of this station features Station Facilities and is located at the same Y-Axis as the Concourse. However, the Passageway lays outside the gate area and only provides access between the NR Shops and the area to the north of this station. It is NOT directly accessible with the concourse and the platforms of this station.
  • At the planning stages, this station was planned to be a Ground Station. However, it was later modified to be a Pseudoground Station. This also makes this station the first Pseudoground Station to be situated on a branch line.

History[]

  • August 3 2023: The Island on which this station is located (Kioku) completed reclamation works.
  • August 5 2023: The Island on which this station is located completed road pavement and connection to Centopia Island.
  • August 13 2023: This Station began construction.
  • August 23 2023: This Station completed construction.
  • August 29 2023: This Station began services.
